channel.title: Hürriyet Daily News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Hürriyet Daily News (hurriyetdailynews.com)

item.title: Turkish Airlines launches Yerevan flights amid Armenia-Türkiye thaw
item.description: Turkish Airlines inaugurated direct Istanbul–Yerevan flights on March 11, marking a new step in the slow rapprochement between Armenia and Türkiye, which have never established formal diplomatic relations.

item.title: Türkiye, others condemn Israel’s restrictions on Al-Aqsa access
item.description: Türkiye and seven other Muslim-majority countries on March 11 condemned Israel’s restrictions on Muslim worshippers' access to the Al-Aqsa Mosque during the holy month of Ramadan, calling for the measures to be immediately reversed.

item.title: İncirlik air base is Turkish, not American: Officials
item.description: The İncirlik air base in Türkiye's south is a Turkish facility, not an American one, defense authorities said on March 12 amid rising regional tensions following two drone incidents in the eastern Mediterranean linked to Iran.

item.title: Elderly population share continues to rise in Türkiye, data shows
item.description: Türkiye’s elderly population, defined as individuals aged 65 and over, now accounts for 11.1 percent of the total, signaling a steady demographic shift as fertility rates decline and life expectancy rises, according to the country’s official statistics office.

item.title: Afghan gov't says Pakistan strikes Kabul and border provinces
item.description: Afghan authorities said on Friday that Pakistan had carried out new strikes on Kabul and border provinces, killing four people in the capital.

item.title: 5.5-magnitude quake jolts northern Türkiye
item.description: 5.5-magnitude earthquake struck the northern province of Tokat's Niksar district at 3:35 a.m. on March 13, shaking several nearby provinces and sending residents into the streets, while officials said there were no immediate reports of casualties or major damage.

item.title: Sirens heard at Incirlik air base, key NATO facility in south Türkiye
item.description: Siren were heard early on Friday at Turkey's Incirlik airbase, a key NATO facility where US troops are stationed near the southeastern city of Adana, state-owned Anadolu Agency reported.

item.title: Erdoğan says Türkiye pushing diplomacy to contain Iran crisis
item.description: President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan said Türkiye is engaged in intensive diplomacy to prevent the Iran-centered spiral of violence from widening, as he presented the Atatürk International Peace Award to U.N. Secretary-General António Guterres in Ankara on March 12. Erdoğan said diplomacy and dialogue remain the safest path to a just and lasting peace.

item.title: Oil holds above $100 and stocks fall as Khamenei targets Hormuz
item.description: Oil prices held around $100 Friday and most equity markets dropped after Iran's leader called for the blocking of the crucial Strait of Hormuz and opening up of new fronts in the war against the United States and Israel.

item.title: New strikes hit Gulf, French troop killed in Iraq
item.description: Saudi forces intercepted more than two dozen drones on Friday after renewed Iranian threats against oil facilities, as the regional conflict killed a French soldier in Iraqi Kurdistan.
